Description: Uncovered a GitHub Personal Access Token, potentially leading to unauthorized repository access and sensitive content exposure.
Author: kkwills13
Message:
fix(approval): redact secret-shaped values under neutral keys (N8613) (#44)

summarizeValue previously only redacted on sensitive key-name match or >40 chars, so a short credential-shaped value under a neutral key (id/value/body) was forwarded to the Telegram approval prompt verbatim. Adds validate.LooksLikeSecret (reuses the CategorySecrets detectors) and applies it to every string + bare-numeric value regardless of key name, layered on the existing checks. Positive controls confirm harmless short scalars still render. go test/vet/gofmt clean.

Message:

Manual run verified all checks fire correctly against livedemo/policy.yaml (clean pass)
and a synthetic bad-policy fixture (all error/warning paths triggered).

Description: Uncovered a GitHub Personal Access Token, potentially leading to unauthorized repository access and sensitive content exposure.
Author: kkwills13
Message:
feat(approval): show redacted params in the approval prompt (#13)

The Phase 5 human-approval prompt showed only Agent + Tool — req.Params was
passed but never rendered (telegram.go:57). A human approving a spend or
kill_switch couldn't see the amount or target: they approved an action they
couldn't see. You can't claim 'accountable' if the human consents blind.

Add summarizeParams: a redacted, length-capped summary of the tool-call params
for the prompt. Conservative by design — shows consent-relevant scalars
(amounts, targets, short strings, bools) verbatim, redacts sensitive-looking
keys (secret/token/key/password/auth/...), redacts long values (likely
secrets/blobs) keeping only their length, shows nested objects/arrays as typed
placeholders (never recurses into them), and summarizes a non-object by size
only. Raw params are still never sent to Telegram (nor written to the audit
trail).

Audit finding NockGuard 1d#11 (top-5 adjacent — the 'approve blind' credibility
gap on the accountable claim).

Tests cover: spend amount + kill-switch target shown; sensitive keys and long
values redacted (with explicit no-leak assertions); nested not recursed;
non-object size-only; empty/absent; length cap. go test ./... -race green;
gofmt + vet clean.
